description.zh: 规则描述信息，最长500个字符
description.en: The rule description. The maximum length is 500 characters.
Specifies whether the rule is enabled.

description.zh: 质量规则校验问题处理器列表
description.en: The list of issue handlers for data quality rule verification.

description.zh: 如果是自定义SQL规则，需要用户指定SQL来过滤问题数据
description.en: For a custom SQL rule, you must specify the SQL used to filter problematic data.

description.zh: 规则名称，数字、英文字母、汉字、半角全角标点符号组合，最长255个字符
description.en: The rule name. The name can be a combination of digits, English letters, Chinese characters, and half-width or full-width punctuation. The maximum length is 255 characters.

description.zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Settings page to obtain the workspace ID.
The settings required for sample collection.

description.zh:
规则对于业务的等级（对应页面上的强弱规则），可选的枚举值：
- Normal
- High
description.en:
The severity level of the rule for the business (corresponding to strong/weak rules on the page). Valid values:
- Normal
- High

description.zh: 规则所引用的规则模板唯一标识
description.en: The unique identifier of the rule template referenced by the rule.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or above to use this feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public update-data-quality-rule --id 100001 --name The_table_cannot_be_empty. --enabled true --severity High --description this_is_a_odps_sql_task --project-id 10000 --template-code SYSTEM:table:table_count:fixed --sampling-config SettingConfig=SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27 SamplingFilter=id_IS_NULL Metric=Min MetricParameters=Columns_:_id_,_name_,_SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table --checking-config '{"Type":"Fixed","Thresholds":{"Expected":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_=_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Warned":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"100.0"},"Critical":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.05","Value":"100.0"}},"ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m"}' --error-handlers Type=SaveErrorData ErrorDataFilter=SELECT_0_FROM_tb_api_log_WHERE_id_IS_NULL --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
